summary: Clue to turning the stuck statue during Find the Blood of Lathander.

fields.Puzzle: In the western hall of the Inquisitor’s Chambers, turn the southern statue west and the northern one east. The southern statue takes a passive DC 25 Athletics check to move. Apply Grease or attack it if that fails. Turning both opens the secret passage.
fields.Acquisition: Rosymorn Monastery near the double doors at X 102, Y 27.
